detail: DNS, overlap, ownership and archive-integrity preflights refused unsafe installation.
The signed core booted, the public ID matched the receipt and the source-restricted account passed its permission controls.
LAN HTTPS access, private service isolation and owner forwarding were checked with live traffic.
Healthy reimport preserved owner access, installation identity and running processes. The stopped control command was repaired.
Management remained available and admission stayed gated until signed bootstrap recovered.
Real scheduled recovery, wrong-service refusal, component isolation, backoff and emergency suppression passed.
